SPACE ROGER

International Space Exploration & Technology Team

Who We Are

Space Roger is an international team of six members representing Bangladesh, Kazakhstan, France, Pakistan, Rwanda, and Russia. United by a shared passion for science, technology, and space exploration, we bring together diverse perspectives and technical skills to solve challenges through innovation and collaboration.

Analyze. Discover. Explore - Our Goal
summary:
FIMU (FITS Intelligence & Mapping Utility) is an AI-assisted astronomical intelligence platform designed to simplify the exploration, visualization, and analysis of SPHEREx mission data. Developed by Team Space Roger, FIMU transforms complex astronomical FITS datasets into accessible visual insights through an interactive web-based application.

The platform enables users to search astronomical objects using object names or celestial coordinates (RA/Dec), retrieve relevant astronomical data, visualize infrared observations, and compare observations across different dates. It also incorporates AI-powered explanations to help users understand astronomical objects, identify unusual observational variations, and interpret complex scientific information.
By integrating SPHEREx's 102 near-infrared spectral bands with astronomical visualization and intelligent data interpretation, FIMU aims to bridge the gap between raw scientific datasets and meaningful astronomical discoveries.
Our vision is to make advanced astronomical data more accessible to researchers, students, and space enthusiasts while supporting the scientific exploration of our universe.
details:
Making the universe easier to explore, one dataset at a time.

FIMU is an interactive astronomical intelligence and visualization platform developed to improve access to SPHEREx mission data.

Built using Python and Streamlit, the application combines astronomical data retrieval, FITS file processing, scientific visualization, and AI-assisted interpretation into a unified environment.

Key features include:

Astronomical Object Search: Search using object names or Right Ascension (RA) and Declination (Dec) coordinates.

FITS Data Visualization: Convert complex FITS astronomical datasets into accessible visual representations.

Multi-Date Comparison: Compare astronomical observations across different observation dates.

Infrared Data Exploration: Explore SPHEREx observations across its 102 near-infrared spectral bands.

AI-Assisted Interpretation: Generate understandable explanations of astronomical data and scientific observations.

Anomaly Exploration: Highlight unusual variations that may deserve further scientific investigation.

Interactive Interface: Explore astronomical information through an intuitive web-based dashboard.

FIMU is designed to reduce the technical barriers associated with astronomical data analysis. Instead of requiring users to manually process complex scientific files, the platform provides an integrated workflow for retrieving, visualizing, and interpreting astronomical observations.

Our ultimate goal is to transform astronomical datasets into accessible scientific knowledge and encourage broader participation in space science.
